nuggets.text: Shaquille O'Neal, performing as DJ Diesel, headlines the Tar Heels' Chapel Thrill pregame party before the ETSU game.
The Tar Heels are celebrating the 100th season of Kenan Stadium, which hosted its first game on Nov. 24, 1927.
Fifty-seven Tar Heels made their first trip out of the country for the season opener in Dublin, Ireland.
Kicker Aeron Burrell never tried a field goal in two seasons at LSU, then made two in his Tar Heel debut.
Timir Hickman-Collins has made the Dublin opener trip twice: with Florida State in 2024 and the Tar Heels in 2026.
Xavier Lewis was MVP of the Dublin opener after piling up 4.5 tackles for loss and two sacks against TCU.
The Tar Heels have won 25 straight games against FCS opponents, a streak dating back to 2000.
The Tar Heels have had a live ram mascot named Rameses since 1924, and the ram's horns are painted Carolina blue.
The Tar Heels held TCU scoreless for the final 49 minutes of their 15-10 win in Dublin.
Saturday is the first-ever meeting between the Tar Heels and the Buccaneers.
